senses.definition: n.m. id. (cf. the rare Arabic ثُدٌ, Lane333 BaZMG xli. 637);—שׁ׳ abs., of mother Jb 24:9; cstr. (fig., c. יָנַק): שׁ׳ מְלָכִים Is 60:16, שׁ׳ תַּנְחֻמֶיהָ 66:11, i.e. the consolations of Jerusalem.
